submissions.title: Texas governor-elect pledges moratorium on new data center approvals
submissions.excerpt: could put 13.3 gigawatts of announced Texas data center projects at risk
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: statewide (Texas). Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governor's race on Nov 3-4, 2026, and pledged to issue a moratorium on all data center approvals until the Legislature passes new rules - effectively extending Gov. Abbott's existing Sept 21, 2026 TCEQ permitting freeze (tied to pending ERCOT/TWDB grid and water audits). Jefferies estimated the pledge could put 13.3 GW of announced Texas projects at risk. Potentially touches many tracked TX projects: Stargate Milam County, Microsoft Pecos, CyrusOne Freestone, Abilene Clean Campus (Crusoe), Aligned Caprock, Cipher Black Pearl, Compass Meridian, Crusoe Goodnight, Fluidstack Abernathy, IREN Childress, IREN Sweetwater, Meta El Paso, Nscale Barstow, QTS-Lancium Hall County, and Stargate Shackelford County. Hinojosa takes office Jan 19, 2027; the ERCOT audit (due mid-Dec 2026) and the Legislature's Jan 2027 session are the near-term items to watch. This is a high-impact but ~3.5-week-old development (election was Nov 3-4) - flagging in case an earlier daily run has not already captured it; treat as a known/duplicate candidate if so.
